neighbours.label: an action reported as already completed ('has completed', 'already ... successfully')
fire: When the upload has finished, close the browser tab.
If the backup has already completed, skip this step.
Once the paint has dried completely, add a second coat.
The installer reports that the update was applied successfully.
After the dough has risen, punch it down gently.
Check whether the payment has already been processed.
When the kettle has boiled, pour the water over the leaves.
The script exits once all files are copied successfully.
quiet: Before the upload starts, open a new browser tab.
If the backup is scheduled for tonight, skip this step.
Before you start painting, sand the wall lightly.
The installer asks which version of the update to apply.
Before the dough rises, cover it with a cloth.
Check whether the payment method is still valid.
While the kettle heats, put the leaves in the pot.
The script asks for a folder name before copying files.
